name: Know your Marines and look out for their welfare
definition: One of the most important principles, you should know your Marines and how they react to different situations. This knowledge can save lives. A Marine who is nervous or lacks self-confidence should never be put in a situation where an important, instant decision must be made. Knowledge of your Marines' personalities will enable you, as the leader, to decide how to best handle each Marine and determine when close supervision is needed.

terms.label: know your Marines and look out for their welfare

rows.situation: When you assign work to someone you barely know
rows.under: Treats them as a seat and a skill list.
rows.justRight: Knows how they work under pressure, what they carry outside the job, and when they need a closer check.
rows.over: Collects personal detail they did not offer and uses it as leverage.

rows.situation: When someone on the team is struggling
rows.under: Waits for them to bring it, or treats it as a performance problem only.
rows.justRight: Asks, names the load you can see, and gets them help that actually lands.
rows.over: Takes over their life and becomes the person they cannot tell the truth to.

rows.situation: When a high-stakes call has to be made fast
rows.under: Hands it to whoever is free, including the person who freezes under that kind of pressure.
rows.justRight: Puts the person who can make that call on it, and stays close to the person who cannot yet.
rows.over: Protects people from every hard assignment, and they never get stronger.

rows.situation: When your comfort and their welfare are in the same choice
rows.under: Takes the easy slot and leaves them the leftover.
rows.justRight: Puts their rest, food, and recovery ahead of yours, and still holds the standard.
rows.over: Performs self-sacrifice so loudly that they cannot accept ordinary help.

rows.situation: When someone brings you a problem outside the work
rows.under: Says it is not your job and sends them away.
rows.justRight: Takes it far enough that they have a next step and a person who can help.
rows.over: Becomes their only fixer, and the work they own stops moving.
